global_access_control.description: Enable or disable access control (restricts LNS to authorized IPs only).

global_port.description: UDP port for L2TP control traffic (standard is 1701).

global_require_auth.description: Require mutual authentication (PAP/CHAP) for all L2TP connections.

global_ipsec_suffix.description: Optional suffix appended to IPSEC security associations (e.g., '@example.com').

global_debug_avp.description: Debug verbosity level for AVP parsing (0=off, 1=normal, 2=verbose).

global_debug_network.description: Debug verbosity level for network packet tracing (0=off, 1=normal).

global_debug_state.description: Debug verbosity level for state machine events (0=off).

global_debug_tunnel.description: Debug verbosity level for tunnel management (0=off).

lns_list.description: List of LNS (L2TP Network Server) sections — one per tunnel endpoint or customer.

name.description: Unique name for this LNS section (required for identification).

ipsec.description: IPSEC mode: 'yes', 'optional', or 'no'. Requires xl2tpd with IPSEC support.

ip_range.description: CIDR range (e.g., '192.168.10.0/24') from which client IPs are assigned.

local_ip.description: Local IP address of the server used as the LNS endpoint.

ppp_profile.description: Name of the PPP profile (from [ppp <name>] section) to apply to sessions.

min_session_id.description: Minimum session ID value (for debugging or isolation).

max_session_id.description: Maximum session ID value (for debugging or isolation).

access_list.description: Comma-separated list of allowed source IPs (e.g., '10.0.0.0/8,192.168.0.0/16').

ppp_options_comment.description: Optional comment describing global PPP options (not rendered into config).

ppp_options.description: Comma-separated list of global PPP options (e.g., 'auth, noauth, require-pap, require-chap').

ppp_profiles.description: List of named PPP option profiles, referenced by LNS sections.

name.description: Unique name for the PPP profile.

options.description: Comma-separated PPP options specific to this profile (e.g., 'mtu 1400, noauth, require-chap').
